poster.hook: Keeper of the bell. Did not see the thief. Has questions.

story.appearance: Broad-shouldered, sun-creased, grey streak through dark braids. Wears chain under a salt-stained grey habit and carries a warhammer she calls Matins.
story.concept: Vell has kept the Saltmere bell for nineteen years, ringing it before every storm, oiling its yoke, and burying the drowned that wash up anyway. She is patient, practical, and slow to anger, and she has never once missed a ringing. Three nights ago she fell asleep in the tower.
story.stake: The bell was stolen on her watch. If the drowned reach the town tonight, every death is on her.
story.goal: Get the bell back into the tower and ring it before the tide turns.
story.secret: She wasn't asleep. She heard the thief, saw it was Rook — the boy she once pulled from the surf — and let him go. She told herself he'd bring it back.
story.voice: Low and even, like she's reading a liturgy. Calls everyone 'child', including people older than her.
mannerisms: Touches the bell-shaped holy symbol before she speaks hard truths
Counts under her breath when she's angry
Hums the old storm-hymn while she works
story.trinket: A clapper-tongue from the bell's first casting, worn smooth

ties.text: Pulled him out of the surf when he was nine. Knows he took the bell — and let him.
ties.public: She pulled him from the surf when he was nine

ties.text: Odo sings the storm-hymn every season. She finds him exhausting and would die for him.
ties.public: She tells him to hush; he never does

story.intro: "I'm Vell. I keep the bell. Kept. Let's go get it back, children."

features.name: Resourceful
features.text: You gain Heroic Inspiration whenever you finish a Long Rest.

features.name: Divine Order: Protector
features.text: Trained for battle: you have Martial weapon and Heavy armor training.

features.name: Channel Divinity
features.text: Two uses; regain one on a Short Rest and all on a Long Rest. Options: Divine Spark, Turn Undead, Preserve Life.

features.name: Divine Spark
features.text: Magic action: point your holy symbol at a creature within 30 ft. Roll 1d8 + 4 and either heal it that much or deal that much Necrotic or Radiant damage (Con save for half).

features.name: Turn Undead
features.text: Magic action: each Undead of your choice within 30 ft makes a Wis save against your spell DC or is Frightened and Incapacitated for 1 minute (ends if it takes damage).

features.name: Sear Undead
features.text: When you Turn Undead, each Undead that fails the save also takes 4d8 Radiant damage.

features.name: Disciple of Life
features.text: When a spell you cast with a slot restores HP, the target regains extra HP equal to 2 + the slot level.

features.name: Preserve Life
features.text: Channel Divinity: restore up to 25 HP, divided among creatures within 30 ft who are Bloodied (none can be raised above half their HP max).

features.name: Healer: Battle Medic
features.text: Utilize action with a Healer's Kit: a creature within reach can spend one Hit Die; it regains that roll + 3 HP. You also reroll any 1s on healing dice.

features.name: Magic Initiate
features.text: Light and Thaumaturgy cantrips; cast Sanctuary once per Long Rest without a slot.

attacks.name: Toll the Dead
attacks.note: 2d12 if the target is missing any HP

spells.name: Sanctuary
spells.note: Magic Initiate; 1/long rest without a slot

spellcasting.note: Prepares 9 cleric spells after a Long Rest; domain spells are always prepared.

attack.name: Toll the Dead
attack.note: 2d12 if the target is missing any HP

attack.name: Word of Radiance
attack.note: Each creature of your choice you can see within 5 ft
